title: Development and validation of a machine learning-based prediction model for intraoperative hypothermia in Chinese patients undergoing gastrointestinal surgery.
summary: Five ML methods were compared in 418 gastrointestinal-surgery patients for intraoperative hypothermia; logistic regression was best (test AUC 0.872), and a six-feature nomogram scored 0.877. Retrospective single-center validation only. The bibliographic records retrieved do not state an author affiliation.
